verdict.rationale: Delegated authority is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, but nothing in the pack publishes what a third party may or may not do on a filer's behalf. The only nearby items are passing mentions of 'Filing Administrator functions' and municipal 'administrators' on the Gateway, with no description of scope, authorization forms or signature rules. The Secretary of State's own sites (ohiosos.gov, bsportal) returned 403 at robots.txt, so no first-party delegation documentation could be confirmed.
